decisions.reason: The candidate's existing message-146 MODIFY already adds NFT to referral_code_locations, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Adding the NFT as another referral-code display location does not change the already optional confirmation email or its mint-number content.
Referral-code display on the NFT does not change the reward behavior for mints submitted without a referral code.
The added referral-code display location does not alter which asset is minted or the mint-fulfillment behavior.
The referral-code display-location change does not alter mint price, commissions, founder proceeds, or prize-pool funding.
Displaying the referral code on the NFT does not change badge triggers or referral-milestone thresholds.
The referral-code display-location change does not affect Transak, supported payment methods, or wallet requirements for fiat minting.
Displaying a referral code on the NFT does not change which sales fund prize pools or the funding duration.
The referral-code display-location change has no bearing on the deferred Discord community server.
The referral-code display-location change does not alter prize announcements, payout mode, or claim interaction.
Displaying the referral code on the NFT does not change winner eligibility, ticket weighting, or Chainlink VRF selection.
The referral-code display-location change does not affect the required flat secondary-sale royalty.
